identity.mission: Create a high-performance, dark-themed sports recruiting CRM that feels like a professional analytics tool.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Sports Broadcast' aesthetics with 'SaaS Productivity'.
Emotion First: The UI should feel 'Locked In' and 'Focused'.
Content is King: Data tables must be readable but beautiful.
Contrast: High contrast text on dark backgrounds.

typography.instructions: Use 'Barlow Condensed' (weights 600-900) for all Page Titles, Section Headers, and Statistic Numbers to give an athletic feel. Use 'Inter' for all body text, table data, and inputs for maximum legibility.

visual_enhancers.gradients: None for backgrounds. Subtle linear gradients allowed on primary buttons only.
visual_enhancers.textures: Noise texture overlay (opacity 0.02) recommended for the main background to reduce banding.

recruiting_board.structure: Collapsible sections based on Status. Each section contains a table.

program_detail.layout: Left sidebar (School Info) + Main Content (Tabs: Interactions, Coaches, Notes).

components.cards: Flat, dark slate (#1e293b) background, 1px border (#334155), rounded-lg. No massive shadows.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or small radius (rounded-md). High contrast text. Primary: Blue-600. Secondary: Slate-700.
components.tables: Dense. Row height 48px. Header text uppercase and tracking-wider. Alternating row colors (optional, prefer hover states).
components.badges: Pill shaped. Solid background or Bordered with transparent bg. Font size xs, font-weight bold.
components.navigation: Top bar. Logo left. Tabs center. Profile right. Active tab gets a bottom border (2px) + text glow.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-4 h-4 for small, w-5 h-5 for medium).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add '@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@400;600;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');' to index.css immediately.

2. SETUP TAILWIND: Configure the colors in tailwind.config.js to match the 'colors' section above. Use CSS variables for flexibility if needed, but hardcoded Slate colors are fine for this specific dark theme requirement.
3. SHADCN OVERRIDES: Update Shadcn components to use the dark slate palette. Ensure Popovers and Dialogs have the correct background (#1e293b) and border colors.
4. RECRUITING BOARD: This is the core feature. Build a robust 'GroupedTable' component that can handle the sections (Active, Contacted, etc.). It needs to look like the screenshots.
5. MOCK DATA: Generate realistic mock data for Universities (using the images provided), Coaches, and Interactions.
6. USE SONNER: For all success/error toasts.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
